# Differential grep cases: name<TAB>rg arguments (shell words). Each runs inside the corpus from
# tests/grep_oracle.h as `rg --sort path --no-heading --path-separator / ARGS .`; the expected
# output (tests/fixtures/grep/NAME.out) is ripgrep 15's, regenerated by scripts/diff_grep.sh --update.
literal_basic	-n hello
literal_column	-n --column hello
ignore_case	-n -i hello
smart_case_lower	-n -S secret
smart_case_upper	-n -S Secret
unicode_fold_sigma	-n -i 'σίσυφος'
unicode_fold_kelvin	-n -i -o 'k'
unicode_fold_long_s	-n -i 'secret'
unicode_fold_e_acute	-n -i 'CAFÉ'
sharp_s_simple_fold	-n -i 'strasse'
fixed_strings	-n -F 'foo-bar'
fixed_strings_meta	-n -F '(foo)'
fixed_strings_ci	-n -F -i 'SHORT HELLO'
word_foo	-n --column -w foo
word_dash_foo	-n --column -w -- '-foo'
word_hash_foo	-n --column -w '#foo'
line_regexp	-n -x 'foo'
line_regexp_regex	-n -x 'line \d+ marker'
invert	-n -v e
invert_count	-c -v e
count	-c line
count_matches	--count-matches hello
files_with_matches	-l hello
only_matching	-n -o 'he[l]+o'
vimgrep	--vimgrep 'o\w'
context_both	-n -C1 match
context_after	-n -A2 match
context_before	-n -B2 match
context_max_count	-n -A1 -m2 match
max_count	-n -m1 hello
empty_lines	-n '^$'
end_anchor	-n 'x$'
start_anchor	-n '^(foo|bar)'
crlf_default	-n 'alpha$'
crlf_mode	-n --crlf 'alpha$'
crlf_beta	-n 'beta\r$'
text_anchor_A	-n '\Ahello'
text_anchor_z	-n 'hello\z'
dot_unicode	-n -o 'caf.'
dot_invalid_utf8	-n -o '.\shello'
class_unicode_word	-n -o '\w+ hello'
class_digits	-c '\d{5}'
alternation	-n -o 'needle_at_end|nested|emoji'
lazy_repeat	-n -o 'l.+?o'
boundary_unicode	-n -o '\bfoo\b'
boundary_ascii	-n -o '(?-u:\b)foo(?-u:\b)'
utf16_le	-n 'second line'
utf16_emoji	-n -o '😀'
utf16_be	-n 'big endian'
bom_column	-n --column 'bom'
binary_text	-n -a hello
binary_report	-n --binary hello
hidden	-n --hidden hello
no_ignore	-n --no-ignore hello
glob_include	-n -g '*.txt' -g '!plain*' hello
long_line_needle	-n -o needle_at_end
pathological	-c '(a*)*b'
many_alts	-c 'line (1|22|333|4444|19999)\b'
multi_pattern	-n -e alpha -e gamma
